name: DNA Reverse Complement
description: Compute the reverse complement of a DNA sequence: complement each base (A↔T, G↔C) then reverse. This is the sequence of the antiparallel strand — the fundamental operation in primer annealing, PCR amplification, and double-strand representation. The DNA 2-bit encoding makes complement a bitwise NOT on the base bits; reverse is a word-order swap. Both operations are purely structural on the packed representation — no arithmetic required.
author: system

pipeline.note: Bitwise NOT on each 2-bit base pair in packed words
Reverse the word order (and base order within words)

validation: reverse_complement(ATGC) = GCAT (4 bases). reverse_complement(reverse_complement(seq)) = seq for all seq. Complement map: A→T=1bit flip, T→A, G→C, C→G.
